title: Practice within the pharmacist's own education, training and experience
rule_summary: A pharmacist shall practice pharmacy within the scope of his or her education, training and experience AND within the recognized pharmacist scope of practice. The two limbs are cumulative, so an act that is lawful for the profession generally may still be outside the scope of a particular pharmacist who lacks the training and experience for it.
exam_relevance: Tests the separation of professional scope from individual competence, which candidates routinely collapse into a single question.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: Assuming that whatever pharmacists generally may do, this pharmacist may do
Treating employer authorisation or willingness as a substitute for training and experience
Confusing it with technician scope of practice
